lines.en: label utaspring5:
scene utafirstkiss1
She did wind up falling asleep, but she wouldn’t let me carry her back.
lines.zh: 她最后确实睡着了，可她不肯让我背她回去。

lines.en: I offered, of course. I can’t imagine she weighs more than a large backpack. And considering I carry the burden of thousands if not millions of years of having my mind rewritten, I don’t think it’d be a problem.
lines.zh: 我当然提出了。我想她应该不会比一个大背包重。而且考虑到我背负的是几千甚至几百万年记忆被反复重写的重担，我觉得这不成问题。

lines.en: We stopped by our gazebo, but only for a few minutes. Only out of habit.
lines.zh: 我们在凉亭那儿停了一下，不过只待了几分钟。纯粹是出于习惯。

lines.en: It’s nearly 3:00 AM now. And while I feel bad for keeping her out so long, I’ve come to accept that she {i}wants{/i} this.
lines.zh: 现在快凌晨三点了。虽然让她在外面待这么久我挺过意不去，但我已经接受了这一点——她{i}想要{/i}这样。

lines.en: {i}Why{/i} she wants this, I’ll never be able to understand. But of course that’s just me {i}telling{/i} myself I’ll never be able to understand when, in all actuality, I was just like her once. Just more physical and less virtual.
lines.zh: 她{i}为什么{/i}想要这样，我永远也不会懂。当然，那不过是我{i}告诉{/i}自己永远也不会懂罢了，事实上，我曾经就跟她一样。只是我那时候更实体、更少虚拟。

lines.en: I know what it’s like to want someone you shouldn’t. And while that’s taken on a new meaning as I’ve gotten older, I’ve sort of always been that way.
lines.zh: 我知道想要一个你不该要的人是什么感觉。虽然随着年龄增长，这句话有了新的含义，但我大概一直都是那样的人。

lines.en: Uta can still grow out of it, though. There’s a chance she realizes once more how close to destruction she is. There’s a chance {i}I{/i} could be the next one physically harmed for wanting her.
lines.zh: 不过 Uta 还有机会长大、摆脱它。她有可能再次意识到自己离毁灭有多近。也有可能有那么一天，{i}我{/i}会因为想要她而成为下一个受到实际伤害的人。

lines.en: But there’s a problem.
lines.zh: 但有个问题。

lines.en: I don’t {i}want{/i} to protect her. I want to hurt her. Every day. Every night. Every minute for the rest of my life — because there is something {i}different{/i} here. I just...
lines.zh: 我不{i}想{/i}保护她。我想伤害她。每一天。每一夜。余生里的每一分钟——因为这里有什么东西是{i}不一样{/i}的。我只是……

lines.en: I haven’t figured out how to explain it yet.
lines.zh: 我还没想好该怎么解释。

lines.en: : I had fun tonight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我今晚玩得很开心，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’d hope so considering how late I kept you out.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我让你在外面待到这么晚，希望如此吧。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss2
: If anything, I’d say that I’m the one who kept {i}you{/i} out by dragging you across town to a secret tunnel and then falling asleep in your lap.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我觉得是我拖着你跑遍全城去了一条秘密隧道，然后在你腿上睡着了，所以是我让{i}你{/i}在外面待到这么晚。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess so. But on the bright side, the break in flirting gave my penis a chance to not be erect anymore. So that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概吧。不过往好处想，调情的中断总算让我的鸡巴有机会不再勃起了。所以挺好的。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss3
: Reaaaaaally? Even though you’re right outside of my room?
lines.zh: : 真~~~~的吗？哪怕你现在就在我房间外面？

lines.en: : I sure am. But this is just one more night of unending temptation since I know you aren’t actually going to invite me in.
lines.zh: : 千真万确。不过这也不过是又一个充满无尽诱惑的夜晚，因为我知道你其实不会请我进去。

lines.en: : So? Doesn’t mean there won’t be fantasies. I know just how much you adore Uta {i}and{/i} Uta-chan. There is no escape from the effect I have on your penis.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？不代表就不会有幻想。我太清楚你有多迷恋 Uta {i}和{/i} Uta 酱了。我对你的鸡巴造成的影响，你是逃不掉的。

lines.en: : Same goes for you and the way you look at me then.
lines.zh: : 那你看我的眼神也是一样。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss4
: You wanna know what I’m gonna do when I get inside, Akira?...
lines.zh: : 你想知道我进去之后要干什么吗，Akira？……

lines.en: : Yes. A thousand times, yes.
lines.zh: : 想。一千次，都想。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss5
: Pass the frick out, that’s what. I’m still eepy from the lap-nap. And I’ve gotta wake up to get ready for school in like two hours.
lines.zh: : 倒头就睡，就这样。腿上那一觉害我到现在还困。而且我大概两小时后就得起床准备上学了。

lines.en: : A tease right up ‘til the end. Like always.
lines.zh: : 到最后一刻还在撩。跟往常一样。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss6
: That won’t ever change either.
lines.zh: : 这一点也永远不会变。

lines.en: : Not even if we were together?
lines.zh: : 就算我们在一起了也不变？

lines.en: : Probably {i}more{/i} if we were together. Teasing you makes me happy. It’s how I check to see you’re still interested. And the fact that you still are after all you’ve learned...
lines.zh: : 要是真在一起了，大概会{i}更{/i}变本加厉。逗你让我开心。这是我确认你还有兴趣的方式。而既然你知道了那么多之后依然有兴趣……

lines.en: : That means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 这对我意义重大。

lines.en: : I hope we get to wake up next to each other some day.
lines.zh: : 我希望有一天我们能在彼此身边醒来。

lines.en: : There’s always two hours from now.
lines.zh: : 两小时后不就是了。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss7
: Oh, please. We both know neither one of us would get to sleep at all if you came in tonight.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我们俩都清楚，要是你今晚进来，谁都别想睡。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : I guess I...should just let you go then.
lines.zh: : 那我想……我就放你走吧。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss6
: Should you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I mean, yeah. You’re tired. I’m tired. And if I don’t jerk off after all of this teasing, I think my dick is going to actually explode.
lines.zh: : 我是说，对。你累了。我也累了。而且被你撩成这样还不去打一发，我觉得我的老二真的要炸了。

lines.en: : Hm.
: Why? Second thoughts at work again? Am I actually going to be invited in after all?
lines.zh: : 怎么？临阵又反悔了？难道我真的要被请进去了？
: 不是……

lines.en: : I just think you’re forgetting something.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你忘了点什么。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss8
: Forgetting something?
lines.zh: : 忘了什么？

lines.en: : Mhm~
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~

lines.en: : You know {i}I’m{/i} not gonna make the first move. That’s all on you, buddy.
lines.zh: : 你知道{i}我{/i}是不会先迈出那一步的。这全看你了，老兄。

lines.en: : You...want me to kiss you?
lines.zh: : 你……想让我吻你？

lines.en: : Seems like a fitting way to end the night, doesn’t it? And you’ve missed a million other chances so far, so I figured I might give you a hint this time.
lines.zh: : 作为今晚的收尾，听起来挺合适的，不是吗？而且你到目前为止已经错过无数次机会了，所以我想这次不妨给你点提示。

lines.en: : Is there a problem? Because I know you want me. And you know I want you. So what’s the hold-up?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗？因为我知道你想要我。你也知道我想要你。那还在犹豫什么？

lines.en: : The hold-up is I won’t be able to stop myself.
lines.zh: : 犹豫的是，我停不下来。

lines.en: : Sure you will.
lines.zh: : 你肯定能。

lines.en: : I think you underestimate just how badly I want to fuck you right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你低估了我此刻想操你想得有多厉害。

lines.en: : I think {i}you{/i} underestimate just how much you {i}actually{/i} like me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得{i}你{/i}低估了你{i}到底{/i}有多喜欢我。

lines.en: : And {i}because{/i} you like me, I know you aren’t going to do anything I’m not ready for.
lines.zh: 而{i}因为{/i}你喜欢我，我知道你不会做任何我没准备好的事。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss9
: Either way — worst case scenario is I’m wrong and I finally get to live out my number one fantasy of sleeping with you. I can’t really lose, can I?
lines.zh: : 不管怎样——最坏的情况也不过是我猜错了，然后我终于实现了睡到你的头号幻想。我怎么都不亏，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
scene utafirstkiss10
Standing right in front of her always makes me feel like a giant — yet {i}she’s{/i} the one who seems confident right now.
lines.zh: 站在她面前总让我觉得自己是个巨人——可此刻{i}她{/i}才是看起来胸有成竹的那个。

lines.en: I guess knowing what you want and only wanting {i}one{/i} thing can do that to a person.
lines.zh: 我猜，知道自己想要什么、而且只想要{i}一样{/i}东西，就能让一个人变成这样。

lines.en: I’m the type who wants everything, though. So while I’ve become very skilled in terms of separating myself from {i}other{/i} desires in moments like this, I’m still not great at just accepting them.
lines.zh: 可我是那种什么都想要的人。所以虽然在这种时刻把自己从{i}其他{/i}欲望中剥离出来我已经很在行了，我依然不太擅长坦然接受它们。

lines.en: But maybe...
lines.zh: 不过也许……

lines.en: I can convince myself there {i}is{/i} only one thing I want.
lines.zh: 我可以说服自己，我想要的{i}确实{/i}只有一样东西。

lines.en: And that it’s something she can give me.
lines.zh: 而且是她能给我的东西。

lines.en: Someone I can grow old with and die before.
lines.zh: 一个可以和我一起变老、而我会死在她前面的人。

lines.en: Someone who will tease me by day and pet me by night. Who will stay faithful so long as I am.
lines.zh: 一个白天逗我、夜里摸我的人。只要我忠诚，她也会保持忠诚。

lines.en: Someone who can help me and hold me and a million other things I can already do with other people I have and know, but-
lines.zh: 一个能帮助我、拥抱我、以及做一百万件我早就和别的、我拥有并认识的人做过的事的人，可是——

lines.en: Again...
lines.zh: 又是……

lines.en: Something just feels different.
lines.zh: 总觉得有什么不一样。

lines.en: : The height disparity makes this difficult.
lines.zh: : 身高的差距让这件事有点难办。

lines.en: : The best things in life normally are.
lines.zh: : 人生中最美好的东西通常都是。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss11
: You’re sure about this?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : More sure than you are, apparently. I’d have caved already if I was in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 显然比你确定。我要是处在你的位置，早就缴械了。

lines.en: : But I fall hard and I fall quickly, so...maybe I’m just hoping I’ll be caught this time.
lines.zh: : 可我一旦陷进去就陷得很深很快，所以……也许我只是希望这次有人接住我。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss12
: Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori。

lines.en: : Akira Arakawa.
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa。

lines.en: : I do not have a ring...and I can not promise you that I am worthy of your time {i}or{/i} capable of remaining loyal to you. Do you accept this?
lines.zh: 我没有戒指……也无法向你保证我配得上你的时间，{i}或{/i}者有能力对你保持忠诚。你接受吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But know that I plan on crying a lot every time you break my heart in an effort to make you stop.
lines.zh: : 接受。但你要知道，每次你伤我的心，我都打算大哭一场，好让你停下来。

lines.en: : I will not protect you...nor will I abandon you. You will give yourself to me and only me...and you will receive nothing in return. I can not make you happy and I can not sit still. Do you accept this?
lines.zh: 我不会保护你……也不会抛弃你。你会把自己交给我，只交给我……而你不会得到任何回报。我没法让你幸福，也没法安定下来。你接受吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I will give myself to you and only you. But it’s not like I won’t be getting anything back. It’s time for me to invest in you for a change.
lines.zh: : 接受。我会把自己交给你，只交给你。不过我也不算什么都没得到。该轮到我来投资你了。

lines.en: : By entering into this unofficial covenant with me, you are hereby renouncing your quality as a human being and greatly reducing your self-worth. Do you accept?
lines.zh: : 与我缔结这份非正式的契约，你即此放弃作为人的资格，并大幅贬损你的自我价值。你接受吗？

lines.en: : Yes. You’ve always made me sound more valuable than I actually am anyway.
lines.zh: : 接受。反正你一直都把我说得比实际更有价值。

lines.en: : Any more questions?
lines.zh: : 还有别的问题吗？

lines.en: : One more...and it’s big.
lines.zh: : 还有一个……而且很重要。

lines.en: : I’m ready.
lines.zh: : 我准备好了。

lines.en: : Do you love me?
lines.zh: : 你爱我吗？

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss13
: Yes...
: A thousand times, yes...
lines.zh: : 一千次，都爱……

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss14
scene black
And so one more wish comes true in this world of infinite possibilities.
lines.zh: 于是在这个可能性无限的世界里，又一个愿望成真了。

lines.en: But each and every one comes with a caveat.
lines.zh: 但每一个愿望都附带一个警告。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss15
: {i}Mmm!{/i}
For Uta Ushibori abhorred the idea of entering into {i}any{/i} covenant with someone who didn’t plan on remaining loyal to her and her alone.
lines.zh: 因为 Uta Ushibori 极其厌恶与任何不打算对她忠贞不二、只对她一个人忠贞的人缔结{i}任何{/i}契约。

lines.en: But in her mind, if this was the only way it could ever happen, she was willing to make certain concessions.
lines.zh: 但在她想来，如果这是它唯一可能发生的方式，她也愿意做出某些让步。

lines.en: After all, it was like she said — the best things in life normally {i}are{/i} difficult. And the fact that he was honest about this up front must count for something, right?
lines.zh: 毕竟，就像她说的——人生中最美好的东西通常{i}确实{/i}是艰难的。而他一开始就对此坦诚，总该算点什么吧？

lines.en: In her constant observations of him, she had come to realize that several girls {i}didn’t{/i} know he was stringing them along.
lines.zh: 在对他持续的观察中，她逐渐意识到，有好几个女孩{i}并不知道{/i}他在玩弄她们。

lines.en: Was he only telling {i}her{/i} because he thought she wouldn’t care? That it didn’t matter because she really {i}was{/i} “easy?” No. No, that couldn’t be it. He actually liked her. She could tell. She could {i}feel{/i} it.
lines.zh: 他只对{i}她{/i}说实话，是因为觉得她不会在乎吗？是因为她真的很“随便”所以无所谓吗？不。不，不可能。他是真的喜欢她。她看得出来。她能{i}感觉{/i}得到。

lines.en: But she’d been feeling all sorts of things with no payoff lately. Something had to change.
lines.zh: 可她最近感觉到了各种各样的东西，却没有一样有回报。必须有什么改变了。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss16
But was this “change” really a change at all? Or was her history of giving herself to anyone who showed any amount of interest just setting her up for disaster once more?
lines.zh: 可这个“改变”真的算是改变吗？还是说，她那段把自己交给任何表现出一点兴趣的人的历史，只是又一次把她推向了灾难？

lines.en: : Bye, Kyousuke! Bye, Tomo-kun! See you in lunch!
lines.zh: : 再见，Kyousuke！再见，Tomo 君！午饭见！

lines.en: : Mmm! My bangs are acting up again. How am I supposed to face Koga-sensei like this?
lines.zh: : 嗯！我的刘海又闹脾气了。这个样子让我怎么去见 Koga 老师啊？

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss17
: What are you talkin’ about?! You look fine! Just be yourself! That’s what boys {i}really{/i} like, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？！你看起来很好啊！做你自己就行了！男生{i}真正{/i}喜欢的不就是这个吗，不是吗？

lines.en: : Tch, easy for you to say. You get to go home to a cool older brother and all of his cool friends who probably walk around shirtless and...chop wood and...ugh! These bangs!
lines.zh: : 啧，你说得轻巧。你回家就能见到一个超酷的哥哥，还有他那些超酷的朋友，他们大概还光着膀子走来走去……劈柴什么的……呃！这刘海！

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss18
: My brother and his friends do not walk around shirtless and chop wood. I’m just repeating what I’ve heard the guys say.
lines.zh: : 我哥和他那些朋友才不会光着膀子劈柴。我只是在重复我听到男生们说的话。

lines.en: : There is zero way Kyousuke and Tomo-kun talk about liking girls who just “be themselves.” Boys our age only care about boobs.
lines.zh: : Kyousuke 和 Tomo 君绝对不可能说什么喜欢“做自己”的女生。我们这个年纪的男生只在乎胸。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah...
scene utafirstkiss19
: Yeah, I think we’re both kinda...done for in that department.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得我们俩在这方面……都算是没戏了。

lines.en: : See, this is why I like Koga-sensei. A distinguished gentleman like him is most definitely the type to appreciate a girl for her personality, not her chest.
lines.zh: : 所以啊，这就是为什么我喜欢 Koga 老师。像他那样一位儒雅的绅士，绝对属于欣赏女生内在、而不是胸部的类型。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss20
: Why do you care so much about your bangs then?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么这么在意你的刘海？

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : Akemi, have you really not heard the rumors about him lately?
lines.zh: : Akemi，你真的没听说最近关于他的传闻吗？

lines.en: : Rumors? What rumors? I haven’t heard anything.
lines.zh: : 传闻？什么传闻？我什么都没听说。

lines.en: : Somebody saw Koga-sensei walking out of a love hotel with a high school girl last week.
lines.zh: : 上周有人看见 Koga 老师和一个高中女生从情人酒店里走出来。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss21
: What?! No. No, that can’t be true! He would never!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不。不，那不可能是真的！他绝对不会！

lines.en: : High school? Really? I thought you needed to be 18 to get into places like those.
lines.zh: : 高中生？真的吗？我以为进那种地方得满 18 岁。

lines.en: : Fake ID maybe? I heard a lot of places don’t even check. They sit behind these window things and just take your money.
lines.zh: : 可能是假身份证吧？我听说很多地方根本不查。他们就坐在这种窗口后面，收钱了事。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you heard is definitely not true! Koga-sensei is refined and pure and-
lines.zh: : 反正你听到的绝对不是真的！Koga 老师高雅又纯洁，而且——

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss22
: Uta! Come to the cafeteria with us! They have curry today!
lines.zh: : Uta！跟我们去食堂吧！今天有咖喱！

lines.en: : Maybe next time! I told one of the teachers I’d help them make copies of the handouts for tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 下次吧！我跟一个老师说好了，要帮他复印明天要发的讲义！

lines.en: : Laaaaame! You’re still coming to Mizuya Chaya after school though, right?
lines.zh: : 好~~~~无聊！不过你放学后还是会去 Mizuya Chaya 吧？

lines.en: : Yup! I’ll meet you guys there! Later!
lines.zh: : 嗯！到时候那儿见！回见！

lines.en: : So effortless. How do you even do that?
lines.zh: : 真轻松。你到底是怎么做到的？

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss23
: Who? Me? Do what?
lines.zh: : 谁？我？做到什么？

lines.en: : Talk to boys! Isn’t he the fieldstop for the school baseball team?
lines.zh: : 跟男生说话啊！他不就是学校棒球队的“场地停”吗？

lines.en: : Do you...mean shortstop?
lines.zh: : 你是说……游击手？

lines.en: : Whatever! You just talk to them like they’re no different from us! How?
lines.zh: : 无所谓啦！你跟他们说话的样子就像他们跟我们没什么两样！怎么做到的？

lines.en: : I...just do? I’ve never really thought about it.
lines.zh: : 我……本来就那样？我从来没认真想过。

lines.en: : Suuuuure, Uta. Like we’re going to believe that.
lines.zh: : 得~~~~了吧，Uta。我们才不信呢。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss24
: What?! I’m being serious! I’ve known him and most of the other guys in our class since kindergarten. They barely even register as boys to me.
lines.zh: : 什么？！我是认真的！我和他、还有班上大部分男生从幼儿园就认识了。对我来说他们根本算不上男生。

lines.en: : Mhm. Right. I’m sure that’s what Koga-sensei’s girlfriend would say too.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吗。我敢说 Koga 老师的女朋友也会这么说。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh my god, Becki! Stop! Koga-sensei doesn’t have a girlfriend! He-
lines.zh: : 天哪，Becki！够了！Koga 老师没有女朋友！他——

lines.en: : Hey, do you guys know what time it is?
lines.zh: : 喂，你们知道现在几点了吗？

lines.en: : Just look at the clock. I’m busy making myself beautiful.
lines.zh: : 看钟不就行了。我正忙着把自己变美呢。

lines.en: : It’s 11:33. Fourth period is-
lines.zh: : 11 点 33。第四节课是——

lines.en: : Ahh, shoot! I didn’t realize it was that late! Sorry, guys! Gotta run! I told the teacher I’d have those copies done by next period!
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了！我不知道已经这么晚了！抱歉，各位！我得跑了！我跟老师说好下节课前把那些复印好！

lines.en: : Okaaaay, but you’re still not forgiven for being friends with the baseball goalie!
lines.zh: : 好~~~~吧，不过你跟棒球队守门员是朋友这件事还不能原谅！

lines.en: : Are you just being dumb on purpose? Do you think that makes you cuter or something?
lines.zh: : 你是故意装傻吗？你以为那样会让你更可爱还是怎么的？

: Hey, have you heard the rumor about Koga-sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你听说 Koga 老师的传闻了吗？

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss45
: How he was caught leaving a hotel with some high school girl? Duuuuh. Everyone’s heard that by now.
lines.zh: : 说他被撞见和某个高中女生从酒店里出来？当我没听过啦。这会儿大家都知道了。

lines.en: : I heard he got called into the principal’s office and put on “administrative leave” last period.
lines.zh: : 我听说他上一节课被叫去了校长室，然后被“停职”了。

lines.en: : Ugh, thank God. I had an essay due.
lines.zh: : 呃，谢天谢地。我还有篇论文要交。

lines.en: : Hahah! Thank Ushibori, not me.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！谢 Ushibori 吧，别谢我。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss46
: Ushibori? You mean Uta? Why? What does she have to do with this?
lines.zh: : Ushibori？你是说 Uta？为什么？这事跟她有什么关系？

lines.en: : I heard from Kyousuke’s group this morning that it was probably {i}her{/i} leaving that hotel with him, just wearing a different uniform as a disguise.
lines.zh: : 我今天早上从 Kyousuke 那伙人那儿听说，从那家酒店里出来的人大概就是{i}她{/i}，只是换了身校服伪装一下。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss47
: Uta? Are we thinking of the same girl? Tomboy Uta? “Only hangs out with boys after school” Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？我们说的是同一个女孩吗？假小子 Uta？“放学后只跟男生混在一起”的 Uta？

lines.en: : That’s the one. You’ve seriously never noticed how close she is with like {i}all{/i} of the male teachers? She clearly has a thing for older guys.
lines.zh: : 就是她。你真没注意到她跟{i}所有{/i}男老师都那么亲近吗？她明显对年长的男人有偏好。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss48
: No way. Kyousuke’s probably just trying to start something since she rejected him last year. Uta’s not like that.
lines.zh: : 不可能。Kyousuke 大概只是因为去年被她拒绝而想搞事情。Uta 不是那种人。

lines.en: : Hmm...do you think it could be like one of those compensated dating things then? Maybe her family’s poor? I heard her brother gets into a lot of fights. Maybe he’s in a gang or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你觉得会不会是那种援助交际之类的事？也许她家里穷？我听说她哥老打架。也许他混黑帮什么的？

lines.en: : You’ve been talking to Becki too much. Uta’s just an average girl. I doubt she’d be able to land Koga-sensei even {i}if{/i} he was into that.
lines.zh: : 你跟 Becki 聊太多了。Uta 就是个普通的女孩。我怀疑{i}就算{/i} Koga 老师好那口，她也勾搭不上他。

lines.en: : Maybe...I definitely wouldn’t blame her if she {i}did{/i} nail him, though. I know I would. Koga-sensei is a total hottie.
lines.zh: : 也许吧……不过她要是{i}真的{/i}把他睡了，我绝对不会怪她。换我我也会。Koga 老师简直帅爆了。

lines.en: : God, yes. Seven days a week.
lines.zh: : 天哪，是啊。一周七天都行。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss49
: It was only a matter of time, Uta.
lines.zh: : 只是时间问题罢了，Uta。

lines.en: : You were always destined for this.
lines.zh: : 你注定会走到这一步。

lines.en: : Everyone’s always known.
lines.zh: : 大家一直都知道。

lines.en: : Why couldn’t you just be normal?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就不能正常一点？

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss50
: Why couldn’t you just fall for a boy your own age and...
lines.zh: : 你为什么就不能喜欢一个跟你同年纪的男生，然后……

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss51
: He never said it back...
lines.zh: : 他没把那句话还给我……

lines.en: : He made me admit I love him...and he never even said it back.
lines.zh: : 他让我承认了我爱他……可他从头到尾都没说回来。

lines.en: scene utafirstkiss50
: Whatever. First kiss — complete. Future Uta can figure out how to make him love her.
lines.zh: : 算了。初吻——完成。让未来的 Uta 去想办法让他爱上她吧。

lines.en: scene black
: That’s all she ever thinks about anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正她脑子里想的从来就只有这件事。
